item.title: Nationwide ground stop lifted after hours of travel chaos
item.description: The FAA lifted a rare nationwide ground stop on Friday evening after a communications outage at air traffic control centers. More than 6,600 flights were cancelled and 8,600 delayed, according to FlightRadar24. Officials said travel should recover by the end of the weekend.

item.title: Tanker crashes into docked river cruise ship in New Orleans
item.description: A tanker lost steering on the Mississippi River and struck a docked river cruise ship in New Orleans. All passengers were rescued, and 32 people were taken to hospitals with non-critical injuries. The NTSB has opened an investigation.

item.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins Alaska governor's race
item.description: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins is projected to win the race for Alaska governor, replacing a Republican. He won more than half of first-choice votes, so no ranked-choice count was needed. He will be inaugurated on Dec. 7.
